full.description: This is a clinical photograph showing the skin of the lower extremities in a patient with darker skin tones. The image reveals numerous purpuric lesions, papules, and petechiae distributed across the shins. These skin findings are characteristic of meningococcemia, representing cutaneous manifestations of systemic infection.

random.description: This is a clinical photograph showing skin lesions on the lower extremities of a patient. The image displays hyperpigmented papules, plaques, and annular or ring-like lesions. The appearance is characteristic of cutaneous lesions, potentially related to a dermatological condition such as erythema marginatum, granuloma annulare, or sarcoidosis. These findings indicate a systemic or localized inflammatory skin process.
